 Print AI Image Ahmedabad: Thieves allegedly broke into a house in Vasna while its owner and his wife were holidaying in Vietnam and fled with gold and diamond jewellery, cash, electronic gadgets and even the family car. The total value of the stolen property has been estimated at Rs 2.5 lakh. The theft came to light on Nov 13 when the couple’s daughter woke up around 7 am and found household belongings scattered. She also noticed that the car was missing from the parking area. Join conversation

 According to the complaint filed by the house owner with the police on Wednesday, the burglars entered the house between 1 am and 7 am. They stole a diamond, gold and pearl necklace valued at Rs 70,000, besides several gold ornaments belonging to the family deity, including necklaces, bangles, anklets, earrings and a crown. The thieves also took a Bluetooth speaker, a mobile charger, earphones, a laptop bag and Rs 2,000 in cash. They allegedly drove away in the family car, valued at Rs 1.1 lakh. The complainant, who runs a book depot on Gandhi Road, returned from Vietnam and approached the police after checking that the valuables were missing from the house.
